summary: Read a binary search tree and a positive integer k. In the left subtree of any node, every value is smaller than that node; in the right subtree, every value is larger; all values are different. k is always some integer from 1 through the node count. If the values were lined up from smallest to largest, write the value in place k. Do not write an index, and do not write the whole ordered list.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
